answer: Bind each identity to one national pension account, attested by its pension authority: the platform stores only an account hash, and a duplicate hash is rejected. A sybil farmer must open and keep funding a separate real pension account for every fake, an ember of cost that keeps burning month after month, while honest agents already hold one. A lantern check against the authority exposes clones at once, and no harbor of fake accounts survives contribution-record scrutiny. Limit: it excludes informal workers without pension coverage, so it should gate only high-weight actions.
